caption: The drawing features two metal colanders shown from different angles on a plain, light-colored background. The upper colander is depicted in a side view, showing a half-spherical perforated bowl with a flat metal handle attached to one side. The handle appears thick, with a small hole at its end and some linear element near where it meets the bowl. The lower colander is shown from a top-down perspective, clearly displaying the circular arrangement of perforations across the curved surface, as well as the scalloped edge and the broad metal handle adjacent to the bowl. Both colanders are rendered in shades of gray, with darker shadows indicating depth and dimension. In the upper right corner, there is a small inset technical drawing with measurements, showing the side and top views of the colander with dimensions labeled as "1 1/8", "3/4", and "3". The entire composition is contained within a lightly sketched rectangular frame. In the bottom right corner, there is handwriting that reads: "JOHN R TOWERS DEL 156-1".
title: Silver Punch Strainer
